trial_matrix.ordering: family_order, then n1 ascending, then n2 ascending

signal_semantics.sma: Simple rolling arithmetic mean over contiguous completed 1h closes.
signal_semantics.ema: Pandas-compatible adjust=False recursion alpha=2/(N+1), reset after an admitted 1h source gap.
signal_semantics.dema: 2*EMA(price,N)-EMA(EMA(price,N),N), reset after an admitted 1h source gap.
signal_semantics.post_gap_warmup: A signal is unavailable until the contiguous run length is at least max(n1,n2).
signal_semantics.entry: At completed-bar t, enter long only on short_MA(t)>long_MA(t) and short_MA(t-1)<=long_MA(t-1).
signal_semantics.exit: At completed-bar t, exit to cash only on short_MA(t)<long_MA(t) and short_MA(t-1)>=long_MA(t-1).
signal_semantics.fill: Execute at the next contiguous 1h candle open; if that fill candle is absent or outside the scored fold, the signal is not filled.
signal_semantics.fold_state: Reset portfolio/position at every Development evaluation fold; indicator history remains point-in-time and may use earlier Development candles.
signal_semantics.terminal: Mark open positions to the final scored close; do not force an exit.

numeric_policy.rationale: HSSE-002 is a broad Development search surface. HSSE-003 must exact-recompute every proposed survivor before any freeze.
numeric_policy.threshold_borderline_policy: A trial within 1e-9 absolute distance of a hard numeric gate cannot be accepted without HSSE-003 exact recomputation.
